canvas_board.title: Pilot planning board
canvas_board.body:
01 · Listen
First-morning friction
Eight starter interviews
Six paused after sign-in

02 · Design
One useful task
One named reviewer
One clear next action

03 · Pilot
Run two cohorts
Check task completion
Count setup questions

Access
Confirm the account
and default workspace.

Example
Show a completed task
with room to make it theirs.

Review
Give each starter a person
who will answer today.

Input
Interview notes

Decision
Ready to pilot?

Output
Rollout decision
